messages:
neal-sales: Heads up 11 - Meridian Health wants a concise POC next week. Goal: sustain 300 qps, p95 < 350ms, p99 < 700ms, demonstrate coldstart behavior and CMK for embedding storage. Need runbook + two price points (12mo committed Dedicated, 1mo hosted PoC).

ren-eng: We'll do hosted control + dedicated reserved profile. Ask Meridian for sample traces (seq len distribution) so we size batching & KV cache.

tara-ops: What are expected tokens per request? Even rough averages change GPU count significantly.

neal-sales: They sent samples: median 230 tokens in, 140 out; ~70% session reuse (chat).

ren-eng: Great, prefix caching will help. Approx token rate = 300*(230+140) = ~111k tok/s. With current quantized medium at ~12k tok/s per GPU => ~10 GPUs recommended with headroom. Batching cap ~20ms, continuous batching, KV cache on.

lee-sre: For SLOs set batching cap 15-25ms during steady-state. Pre-warm one standby node to reduce coldstarts. Multi-AZ placement to reduce noisy neighbor risk.

ivy-qa: I'll assemble harness: 30m steady @300 qps, 10m microbursts at 3x with session-aware Poisson arrivals, 5 sequential restarts to measure warmup, and a KMS rotation event mid-run. Capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, GPU util, queuing, error rates, and KMS call latency.

neal-sales: Procurement note: Meridian wants CMK details and proof that rotation/audit logs won't stall inference. Any guidance?

ren-eng: Synchronous KMS calls can add ~10-25ms if cross-region. If CMK in same VPC (Dedicated/Private) expect ~5-12ms. Recommend envelope DEK + async KMS for embeddings to avoid per-request blocking. We'll document trade-offs in the SOW.

tara-ops: Draft runbook snippet:
```n- Provision 10 dedicated GPUs (autoscale min 6 / max 14 by token/s)
- Enable KV/prefix cache, batching cap 20ms, session affinity
- Traffic: replay sample traces with 70% session reuse, 30m steady + 10m bursts
- Coldstart: 5 restarts during soak; KMS rotation triggered at minute 35
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/s, queue latency, GPU util, KMS latency, errors
- Fallback: route to smaller model variant and alert if p95 > SLO for >120s
```

lee-sre: Ops playbook: keep one warm standby node, tune autoscale on token/s and tail latency, rollback policy to fallback model. Also include network egress and audit expectations for procurement.

iney-kms-bot: "KMS STATUS: Customer-managed keys (CMK) supported on Dedicated and Private planes. Hosted plane supports envelope encryption; for in-path CMK recommend Dedicated/Private deployment in same VPC."

neal-sales: Tara, can you ballpark prices for the two asks? We'll label as preliminary.

tara-ops: Preliminary estimates: Dedicated (10 GPUs reserved + infra + support) ~$95k/month committed; Hosted PoC (1 month, managed) ~$32k. I'll refine with exact SKU math in runbook.

ivy-qa: Timeline: runbook final Mon EOD, infra ready Tue, POC Wed-Thu, analysis Fri. I'll post results + 1-page exec summary with p50/p95/p99, tokens/M cost, recommended commit, KMS impact.

neal-sales: Perfect. I'll send this plan to Meridian and loop in their security lead for a brief sync. Ping here when results are posted. :thumbsup:
